blocks.text: Create interactive product demos that sell for you

Storylane enables B2B product teams to create interactive demos that prospects can explore on their own. Instead of gating your product behind a demo call, you give prospects a hands-on experience - showing rather than telling what your product does.

The demo creation process captures your actual product screens and overlays guided steps, hotspots, and annotations. Prospects click through a realistic product experience without needing access to a sandbox or demo account. This self-service approach qualifies leads before they reach your sales team.

The analytics reveal which features prospects engage with, where they drop off, and how long they spend exploring. This behavioral data helps sales teams personalize their follow-up and helps product teams understand which features drive the most interest.
Capture your product screens with automatic element detection
Add steps, tooltips, and hotspots for interactive walkthroughs
Let prospects choose their own journey through the demo
Track engagement, completion rates, and feature interest
Embed forms within demos to capture qualified leads
Embed on your website or share via direct links
Interactive demos convert at significantly higher rates than static screenshots or video walkthroughs. Storylane makes creating these experiences accessible without engineering involvement.
Our team can integrate Storylane into your workflow and automate the repetitive parts.
